newsitem.title: UK: IPE oil futures drift lower hit by NYMEX selling.
newsitem.headline: IPE oil futures drift lower hit by NYMEX selling.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures drifted lower, influenced by technical selling by locals on NYMEX crude futures, traders said.
"Its mainly technically-led -- March NYMEX) hit a technical pivot point at $24.34 which triggered some technical selling by the locals," one IPE broker said.
He expected the market to recover as the sellers took profits recovering their shorts at the lower levels.
By 1643 GMT March Brent was trading four cents a barrel down at $23.32 a barrel, wiping out morning gains.
Traders said there was very little volume in the selling.
February gas oil also lost ground but traders said sentiment was mainly being influenced by the weaker U.S. crude and products markets.
The contract was trading $1.25 a tonne lower at $202.50 a tonne at the session lows.
